extracted.name: Apples by the Fire
extracted.description: This recipe stuffs a tart apple with cinnamon and brown sugar, wraps it in foil, then places it in the coals of a fire for a camping or cookout dessert.
instruction_lines: Build a campfire or preheat an outdoor charcoal grill; allow fire to burn until a bed of coals has accumulated. Rake coals into a flat bed on one side of the fire.
Meanwhile, combine brown sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl; spoon into apple core. Wrap apple in a large piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil, twisting extra foil into a tail for a handle.
Place foil-wrapped apple in the coals; cook until softened, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove apple from the coals; unwrap carefully to avoid being burnt by hot sugar.
